5.3 ADMINISTRATION
 Contacts in Canadian offices of six major international accounting firms
 (the "Big 5" plus a sixth international firm) were approached by phone to
 determine if they would be willing to participate in the study. During the
 phone calls, the nature of the research question was explained and details
 of the questionnaire were offered. All firms agreed to participate. The contacts distributed the questionnaires to experienced audit partners across the
 country in their firms. To improve response rates, we asked contacts to write
 a cover note encouraging participation and to be responsible for follow-up.
 To assure anonymity and confidentiality, we told the partner respondents
 not to identify themselves on the questionnaire and to return the completed
 materials to the contact person in a sealed envelope, which was sent on to
 us unopened.
